name: @langwatch/workspace
description: LangWatch repository workspace and contributor command facade.

scripts.test:component: node -e "console.error('No component lane outside the monolith yet: apps/{api,worker,ui} each ship one vitest.config.ts and no jsdom lane. Run pnpm test:unit, or the package suite you mean.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:integration: node -e "console.error('No datastore lane outside the monolith yet: only @langwatch/coding-agent-server declares test:integration. Run that package directly, or pnpm test:unit.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "console.error('No e2e lane yet: the Playwright suite went with the monolith and has no packaged home. dev/tests/agentic-e2e is the surviving end-to-end harness — run it from there.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint --quiet --config .oxlintrc.architecture.json apps packages/features packages/enterprise packages/config packages/design-system packages/handled-error/src packages/prisma-client/src packages/runtime-composition/src
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --quiet --config .oxlintrc.architecture.json apps packages/features packages/enterprise packages/config packages/design-system packages/handled-error/src packages/prisma-client/src packages/runtime-composition/src
scripts.start:prepare:files: pnpm run ensure:ai-gateway-secrets && cp services/langevals/ts-integration/evaluators.generated.ts packages/features/evaluator/contract/src/evaluators.generated.ts && pnpm --filter @langwatch/prisma-client prisma:generate && pnpm --filter langwatch build && pnpm --filter @langwatch/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @langwatch/langy-web generate:langy-skills && pnpm --filter @langwatch/langy-server generate:setup-skill-bodies
